description: Rules that spread the pods across topology domains such as nodes or zones (`topologySpreadConstraints`).

maxSkew.description: Maximum difference in the number of matching pods between any two topology domains.

topologyKey.description: Node label of the topology domain, eg `kubernetes.io/hostname`.

whenUnsatisfiable.description: What happens when the constraint can not be met: `DoNotSchedule` or `ScheduleAnyway`.

labelSelector.description: Selects the pods that are counted when the skew is calculated.

minDomains.description: Minimum number of eligible domains. Only applies with `whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule`.

items.description: A label key of the pod.

matchLabelKeys.description: Label keys of the pod. Their values are combined with `labelSelector` to select the pods that are counted.

nodeAffinityPolicy.description: Whether the node affinity of the pod is honored when the skew is calculated.

nodeTaintsPolicy.description: Whether the node taints are honored when the skew is calculated.
